summary: Three documents that the research tools cannot open (hosts return 403) were read through the owner's browser retrieval and sent to an independent AI review: the Secretary of the Air Force memorandum of 2025-03-17 with the OUSD(P&R) memorandum of 2025-02-03 attached (c04-15), and the congress.gov action histories of H.R. 8628 (c05-17) and H.R. 2641 (c05-23). No stage changed. c04-15 now rests on the primary memoranda rather than an advocacy source for the rescissions, and its open conflict on fertility care is resolved for the Air Force: abortion-related leave and travel reimbursement ended, non-covered assisted reproductive technology keeps administrative absence and travel allowances. Confidence moved 72 to 78, 74 to 76 and 80 to 82. Three other documents (defense acquisition memorandum, CISA budget, FEMA Review Council report) remained blocked at the host edge even in a browser and stay cited by URL only.
title: Three blocked primary documents read through a browser retrieval and integrated
